register: # EG4-LL Battery — HOLDING Register Map (PDF V01.06)
# ALL registers use Modbus FC 0x03 (Read Holding Registers).
# The PDF defines a single address space; R vs RW indicates whether
# FC 0x10 writes are accepted — it is NOT a separate address space.
#   SHORT    16-bit signed int   (2 bytes  two's complement)
#   UINT     32-bit unsigned int (4 bytes); expressed here as _h/_l USHORT pairs.
#            The loader auto-promotes a _h/_l pair to UINT and drops the _h suffix.
#   _8BIT    8-bit unsigned field extracted from a 16-bit register.
#   _8SBIT   8-bit signed field (same addressing as _8BIT but sign-extended).
#            Used for temperature sensor bytes confirmed as s8 in eg4_ll.py.
#   ASCII    Multi-register ASCII string expressed as a register range.
#            The loader concatenates all words and strips null characters.
#   The PDF notes that the high byte of reg 25 carries the heater state
#   (0x80 = on  0x00 = off) and the low byte carries the operating status code.
#   eg4_ll.py confirms: packet[53]=heater hi-byte  packet[54]=status lo-byte.
#   Mapped as two _8BIT entries at 25.b8 and 25.b0.
#   eg4_ll.py reads Charge_OC_Times from offset 91 (hi byte of reg 89) and
#   Discharge_OC_Times from offset 92 (lo byte of reg 89) as unsigned bytes.
#   Mapped as two _8BIT entries at 89.b8 and 89.b0.
#   eg4_ll.py uses s8() (signed) to read sensor bytes. _8SBIT is used here.
#   Two sensors per register: .b8 = high byte  .b0 = low byte.
#   The PDF documents 6 sensors (regs 33-35); eg4_ll.py reads only sensors
#   1-4 (regs 33-34). Sensors 5-6 (reg 35) are included but may read 0.
#   The -50 offset is a BMS firmware encoding not shown in the PDF unit column.
#   The unit_mod in the CSV is 1 (whole degC per LSB after offset is applied).
#   Each affected register is flagged with "offset: raw-50=degC" in its note.
#   Your application layer must subtract 50 from raw reads before display/use.
#   All config register numbers below are ABSOLUTE Modbus addresses verified
#   by back-calculating from eg4_ll.py packet byte offsets:
#   Regs 39-55: between cell data and config blocks; not read by any command.
#   Regs 45-55: within bmsConfig window (offsets 3-24) — code skips them.
#   Regs 73-77: within bmsConfig window (offsets 59-68) — code skips them.
#   These are omitted from the CSV; the batch range calculator will include
#   them in read requests but their values are not decoded.
# CELL DATA BLOCK  (cellCommandRoot: FC 0x03  start=0  count=39)
